summary.text: Jose Cambrils is a Republican state representative from Merrimack 4 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An engineer and engineering executive by background, he was born in Cuba.

paragraphs.text: Jose Cambrils was born in Victoria de Las Tunas, Cuba.
He earned a B.S. in industrial engineering from Northeastern University in 1983 and an M.B.A. in operations management from the University of Massachusetts at Lowell in 1987.
His career experience includes working as an engineer and an engineering executive, and he has been affiliated with the American Numismatic Association.
Ballotpedia lists Cambrils's tenure in the New Hampshire House as beginning in 2020.
In the 2023-2024 session he served on the House Finance Committee and its Division I, and in 2021-2022 he served on the Science, Technology and Energy Committee.
